notes: PAB-MUMBAI-ENVPROP-VADA-PAV-CART-V1, left-edge fixed-canopy master. Session 48 applied the same deterministic style-correction pipeline used for the right-edge master to this binary: source v001 canvas is 1120x1574 with alpha>=32 bbox (219,460)-(894,1071), including 10,482 sub-alpha-8 dust pixels and a baked ground-contact shadow under the wheels. Correction: alpha cleanup keeps only a Gaussian-smoothed alpha>=200 core plus a 4px Euclidean dilation (the raw alpha channel is grainy - +/-10-20 between neighbouring pixels even mid-gradient - so the smoothing pass was needed here to avoid a jagged threshold boundary; the right-edge master's cleaner alpha didn't need it, but the smoothed version was verified to reproduce that master's result bit-for-bit before use). Result: dust 10,482->0 outside the true silhouette (1,587 remaining are legitimate edge antialiasing, verified visually), contact shadow removed, alpha>=32 bbox becomes (219,460)-(894,1058) - a real ~13px shrink at the bottom, because this master's baked shadow blends continuously into the wheel's own contact shadow with no clean boundary; the removed region is the diffuse shadow gradient, not cart structure (verified visually - full wheel, tire, rim spokes, casters all intact). Style flattening: cv2.pyrMeanShiftFiltering (sp=18, sr=45) + light bilateral + PIL contrast x0.78 / saturation x0.75 / brightness x1.06 - same parameters as the right master, for family consistency. Measured: Laplacian-std texture 65.2->46.0, greyscale-contrast std 55.0->40.5, mean HSV saturation 125->69. IMPORTANT: this record is style-correction only, not a placement approval. Unlike the right master, this asset has NEVER been through a Session-46-style controlled measurement/placement test - dimensions/anchor stay at the disabled-draft 0/0 sentinel, and the metadata's own temporary_orientation_note (carried from v001) still flags that orientation may need refinement. Do not wire this into EDGE_PROP_DEFS or a runtime pool without that measurement pass first. Superseded from mumbai_prop_vadapav_cart_fixed_canopy_left_neutral_1x_v001, which is kept unmodified on disk for traceability.
